message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.  
In the United States, “local council” is usually referred to as the **City Council** or the **City Government**. For noise issues, the most common route is through the City of Atlanta’s Police Department or the City’s Code Enforcement office.

### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact |
|------|------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **Gather details** – Note the time, location, type of noise, and any witnesses. | — |
| 2 | **Call 911** – If the noise is an emergency (e.g., ongoing assault, fire, or immediate danger). | 911 |
| 3 | **Call the Atlanta Police Department (APD) non‑emergency line** – For routine noise complaints. | 404‑656‑4000 (non‑emergency) |
| 4 | **Use the City of Atlanta’s online portal** – Many cities allow you to submit a noise complaint online. | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/> and look for “Code Enforcement” or “Noise Complaint.” |
| 5 | **Visit the City Hall or Code Enforcement Office** – If you prefer in‑person filing. | City Hall, 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 |
| 6 | **Follow up** – Keep a record of your complaint number and any correspondence. | — |

### Quick Contact Information

| Agency | Phone | Email | Website |
|--------|-------|-------|---------|
| Atlanta Police Department (Non‑Emergency) | 404‑656‑4000 | — | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/police> |
| City of Atlanta Code Enforcement | 404‑656‑4000 (same line) | — | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/code-enforcement> |
| City of Atlanta 311 Service (general inquiries) | 404‑656‑4000 | — | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |

> **Tip:** If the noise is coming from a commercial property, you may also contact the Atlanta Business Improvement District (BID) or the local zoning office.

### Legal Basis

Atlanta’s noise ordinance is part of the **City of Atlanta Code** (Title 10, Chapter 10 – Noise). Violations can result in fines or other enforcement actions. The ordinance specifies permissible noise levels and quiet hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.).

---

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the APD non‑emergency line, the online portal, or visit City Hall to file your complaint. The city’s Code Enforcement office will investigate and take appropriate action.
